name: Estonia: sole proprietors (FIE)
dueNote: VAT returns are monthly, due on the 20th of the following month. FIE income and social tax are paid in quarterly advances and settled after the annual return; the rest of a year's reserve is released after 1 October of the following year.

presets.label: VAT 24% + income and social tax reserve 40%
Below the VAT registration threshold: reserve 40%

notes: 2026: VAT 24% standard (13% accommodation, 9% books, medicines and press); income tax 22%; FIE social tax 33% of business income. Companies (OÜ) pay no tax on retained profits and are not covered by this pack.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
